# Loading in OpenClaw

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lumitive/lumi-style ~/src/lumi-style
ln -s ~/src/lumi-style ~/.agents/skills/lumi-style
# or <workspace>/skills/lumi-style
```

Invoke: the slash command comes from the name frontmatter field: /lumi-style.

The skill reads `references/` and `tokens/` on demand — no need to attach them manually.

**Symlink rather than copy.** An installed copy silently stranded at 0.1.334 while the repo reached 0.1.337, and a deck was built against three versions of superseded rules. A symlink cannot go stale.

OpenClaw finds `SKILL.md` anywhere under a configured root, up to six levels deep.

Symlinked targets need explicit trust via `skills.load.allowSymlinkTargets` in `openclaw.json`; if the skill does not appear, check that first.

Vendor documentation: https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skills
